error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: The interface hit an unexpected error. Profiles saved in this browser were not touched.

rate.title: Rate Studio
rate.subtitle: Model how stick position turns into rotation speed using the published Betaflight rate mathematics. Everything is computed and stored locally.
rate.profileNameHint: Used when you export or save the profile.

model.title: Rates model
model.help: Both models below are implemented and covered by numeric tests. Switching keeps the raw CLI values and changes how they are interpreted.
model.pendingHelp: Betaflight ships more rates types. OpenRotor Lab lists them but does not simulate them until they are implemented correctly.

actual.name: ACTUAL
actual.desc: Center sensitivity and maximum rate are set directly in °/s; expo shapes the middle of the curve.

betaflight.name: BETAFLIGHT
betaflight.desc: Classic RC Rate, Expo and Super Rate behaviour, including the documented over-crop above RC Rate 2.00.

hint.rcRateActual: Speed at stick center. Stored as rc_rate × 10.
hint.rcRateBetaflight: Multiplies the whole curve. Stored as rc_rate.
hint.expo: Softens the middle of the curve without moving its ends.
hint.srateActual: Speed at full stick. Stored as srate × 10.
hint.srateBetaflight: Pulls the curve up towards full stick.
hint.rateLimit: Hard ceiling applied last, stored as rate_limit.

chart.title: Stick position → rotation speed
chart.hint: Move any slider and the curve updates immediately. Hover or drag over the chart to read values.
chart.empty: Select at least one axis to draw the chart.

table.title: Values at fixed stick positions
table.stops: Table columns are sampled at stick positions {{stops}} of full deflection.
table.deltaHint: Current profile minus the compared profile.

compare.title: Comparison
compare.hint: Draw a second profile on the same chart and read the difference.

presets.title: Defaults and examples
presets.hint: Every reset explains where its values come from.

provenance.betaflight-2025-12-default: Betaflight 2025.12 firmware default rate profile: rates_type ACTUAL, rc_rate 7, expo 0, srate 67, rate_limit 1998.
provenance.example-actual: Example freestyle values for the ACTUAL model (center 90 °/s, max 1100 °/s). Not a firmware default.
provenance.example-legacy: Example classic values for the BETAFLIGHT model (rc_rate 90, expo 0, super rate 70 → 600 °/s max). Not a firmware default.

reset.title: Reset to firmware defaults
reset.body: Restores the Betaflight 2025.12 default rate profile for the ACTUAL model. The legacy BETAFLIGHT model has no firmware default, so it is reset to the documented example above.

export.title: Export
export.hint: Downloads a JSON file with the model, all three axes and the rate limit. Nothing leaves your device.

import.title: Import
import.hint: Reads an OpenRotor Lab profile. The file is validated before anything changes.

profiles.title: Saved in this browser
profiles.storageNote: Profiles are stored in this browser's local storage only. Nothing is uploaded, and clearing site data removes them.
profiles.empty: No profiles saved yet. Save the current setup to keep a backup or to compare it later.
profiles.compareHint: Compare loads a saved profile onto the chart without touching your current values.

profile.nameRequired: Enter a profile name before saving.

storage.unavailable: Local storage is not available in this browser, so profiles cannot be saved.

model.clamped: Some values were clamped to the limits of the {{model}} model.

file.unreadable: The selected file could not be read.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This route does not exist in OpenRotor Lab.

common.lead: This module is announced but not implemented yet. It does not show fake data and it does not pretend to work.

rateCalibration.title: Rate Calibration
rateCalibration.desc: Measure how your sticks actually travel and turn that into rates you can feel.
points: Guide a pilot through a stick sweep and record the real stick positions.
Compare measured travel with the configured endpoints and expo.
Suggest rate values for a target feel instead of guessing.

blackboxLab.title: Blackbox Lab
blackboxLab.desc: Read Betaflight blackbox logs entirely in the browser.
points: Open .bbl/.bfl blackbox logs with a WebAssembly parser.
Inspect gyro, setpoint and PID traces on a shared timeline.
Export charts and a cleaned summary of a tune.

tuneCoach.title: Tune Coach
tuneCoach.desc: Turn log evidence into PID and filter recommendations.
points: Detect oscillations, overshoot and weak noise rejection from logs.
Explain each recommendation and the reasoning behind it.
Keep a history of tunes per drone with before/after comparisons.

droneGarage.title: Drone Garage
droneGarage.desc: Keep a technical passport for every quad you own.
points: Store frame, motor, prop and battery details per build.
Track maintenance: soldering, bearing wear, prop damage.
Link builds to tunes and to the logs they produced.

betaflightTools.title: Betaflight Tools
betaflightTools.desc: Small utilities that remove CLI busywork.
points: Translate a CLI dump into readable, diffable settings.
Build a CLI snippet for a rate, filter or PID change.
Validate a diff before it ever reaches the flight controller.

hardwareConnect.title: Hardware Connect
hardwareConnect.desc: Talk to a flight controller from the browser.
points: Connect over WebSerial or WebUSB with an explicit consent step.
Read the current configuration as a read-only first step.
Write parameters only after a review screen — never silently.

safetyCenter.title: Safety Center
safetyCenter.desc: Preflight checks and safety notes in one place.
points: A preflight checklist covering props, arming and failsafe.
Explain what each Betaflight setting changes in flight.
Warnings for configurations that are known to be risky.

demoMode.title: Demo Mode
demoMode.desc: Walk through the lab with sample data that is clearly marked.
points: A synthetic log and a synthetic build, both labelled as samples.
Guided tours of each module without touching your own data.
A safe way to decide whether the lab fits your workflow.
